notes:
{音階|おんかい} refers to a musical scale—a sequence of notes arranged in ascending or descending order by pitch.

TYPES:
- ⟦{長|ちょう}→長：noentry⟧{音階|おんかい}: major scale
- ⟦{短|たん}→短：noentry⟧{音階|おんかい}: minor scale
- ⟦{半|はん}→半：noentry⟧{音階|おんかい}: chromatic scale
- ⟦ペンタトニック→ペンタトニック：noentry⟧{音階|おんかい}: pentatonic scale

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {音階|おんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to practice scales
- {音階|おんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧: to play scales
- {音階|おんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing scales
